test_title: PYST 23: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 15 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘LATEX’ is written as ‘OFGJC’, and ‘RIGHT’ is written as ‘INTSG. How will ‘SMILE’ be written in that language?
solution:
The table of alphabet place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

 
• **Consonant - are placed there opposite alphabet.**
 
• **Vowel - addition of + 5 in vowel.**

'LATEX' is written as 'OFGJC'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d5d10a57ca35742928f6298f95cbd146e74651de81a101e5449578e49511a54.png] 

And,

'RIGHT' is written as 'INTSG'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80c7d14029ff633992faefcbed234295a6390d3e8a37f597655e8035b92eaa51.png] 

Similarly,

'SMILE' is written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddda03d8f06199a450a46a0651836ca5e9d98331ddea97aeb8e154b4257f0ab6.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"HNNOJ".**
